technical.title: Technical cookies
technical.description: Required for the site to function: client area authentication session, theme preferences and technical routing. They do not profile the user.

analytics.title: Analytics cookies
analytics.description: Allow us to collect aggregated statistics on site usage (pages visited, session duration). Ready for future integrations; no analytics tool is currently in use.

marketing.title: Marketing cookies
marketing.description: Used to profile the user and show personalised ads on other platforms. Ready for future campaigns; no marketing tool is currently in use.

hero.subtitle: Professional management of properties on Lake Como. A team of property managers with years of direct experience on the lake. We handle your property across every channel, in every season.

multiChannel.body: We list your property on the main market channels and adapt the rental formula season by season. In high season we focus on short-stay tourism, in low season we shift to medium-to-long-term lets when more profitable. Your home stays active 365 days a year, with a single point of contact.
bullets: Distribution on Airbnb, Booking, Expedia and other leading platforms

ownerServices.subtitle: From promotion to day-to-day operations, we take care of every aspect of your property with advanced technology and attention to detail.

dynamicPricing.title: Dynamic Pricing
dynamicPricing.desc: A pricing algorithm that optimises rates based on seasonality, demand and competition to maximise your revenue.

bookings.title: Booking Management
bookings.desc: Unified calendar synchronised with Airbnb, Booking.com and Expedia. Zero double bookings, zero stress.

compliance.title: Full Compliance
compliance.desc: CIN, Questura, ISTAT, tourist tax: we handle every regulatory requirement automatically.

hospitality.title: 5-Star Hospitality
hospitality.desc: Professional check-in, certified cleaning, premium linen. Every guest enjoys a top-tier experience.

promotion.title: Multi-Channel Promotion

dashboard.title: Owner Dashboard
dashboard.desc: Track revenue, occupancy and performance in real time. Automatic monthly reports with transparent payouts.

simulators.subtitle: Three simulators to give you a concrete idea of your property's value on Lake Como. Preliminary estimates based on our historical database — the actual figure requires a dedicated analysis with our internal data and proprietary pricing algorithm.

investimento.name: Investment Simulator
investimento.desc: Preview of cash-on-cash return, cap rate and payback period for buyers evaluating an income property.
